entities.summary: Lauri Tukonen is a Finnish professional ice hockey player. Tukonen has played in North America for the Los Angeles Kings organization and is a former member of Finnish clubs, Espoo Blues, Ilves and TPS. He is currently a player development coach for the Calgary Flames organization.
